    scaled = mean_latency_ms / 25.0
    return 1.0 - min(scaled, 1.0)

    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + cpu_req) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + mem_req) / mem_cap
    return max(cpu_after, mem_after)

    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    headroom = 1.0 - peak
    headroom_score = headroom * headroom
    if peak > 0.92:
        headroom_score = headroom_score * 0.15
    elif peak > 0.85:
        headroom_score = headroom_score * 0.40
    elif peak > 0.75:
        headroom_score = headroom_score * 0.70

    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    max_lat = 0.0
    cross = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                lat = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weighted = weighted + rate * lat
                weight = weight + rate
                if lat > max_lat:
                    max_lat = lat
                neighbor_node = ctx.nodes[neighbor.current_node]
                if node.tier != neighbor_node.tier:
                    cross = cross + rate

    proximity = 0.5
    if weight > 0.0:
        mean_lat = weighted / weight
        proximity = proximity_of(mean_lat)
        worst = 1.0 - min(max_lat / 100.0, 1.0)
        proximity = proximity * 0.70 + worst * 0.30
        cross_ratio = cross / weight
        if cross_ratio > 0.0:
            cross_penalty = min(cross_ratio * 0.6, 0.6)
            proximity = proximity * (1.0 - cross_penalty)

    power_idle = node.power_idle_w
    power_max = node.power_max_w
    if power_max < power_idle:
        power_max = power_idle
    power_est = power_idle + (power_max - power_idle) * peak
    efficiency = 1.0 - min(power_est / 200.0, 1.0)

    return headroom_score * 0.50 + proximity * 0.40 + efficiency * 0.10

        destination_pod = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]

        if moved >= budget:
            return out

        source_pod = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
        dest_pod = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]

        both_placed = source_pod.current_node >= 0 and dest_pod.current_node >= 0
        different = source_pod.current_node != dest_pod.current_node

        if both_placed and different:
            source_node = state.nodes[source_pod.current_node]
            dest_node = state.nodes[dest_pod.current_node]
            rate = graph.rate[e]
            current_latency = source_node.latency_to_ms[dest_pod.current_node]
            high_latency = current_latency > 8.0
            high_rate = rate > 0.0

            if high_latency and high_rate:
                source_movable = not source_pod.stateful and not source_pod.has_pdb
                dest_movable = not dest_pod.stateful and not dest_pod.has_pdb
                source_target_util = projected_util(dest_node, source_pod)
                dest_target_util = projected_util(source_node, dest_pod)
                source_not_moved = not has_pod(moved_pods, source_pod.id)
                dest_not_moved = not has_pod(moved_pods, dest_pod.id)
                source_ok = source_movable and (not dest_node.suspended) and source_target_util < 0.72 and source_not_moved
                dest_ok = dest_movable and (not source_node.suspended) and dest_target_util < 0.72 and dest_not_moved

                if source_ok and dest_ok:
                    if source_target_util <= dest_target_util:
                        out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, dest_pod.current_node))
                        moved_pods.append(source_pod.id)
                        moved = moved + 1
                    else:
                        out.append(move_pod(dest_pod.id, source_pod.current_node))
                        moved_pods.append(dest_pod.id)
                        moved = moved + 1
                elif source_ok:
                    out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, dest_pod.current_node))
                    moved_pods.append(source_pod.id)
                    moved = moved + 1
                elif dest_ok:
                    out.append(move_pod(dest_pod.id, source_pod.current_node))
                    moved_pods.append(dest_pod.id)
                    moved = moved + 1
            elif moved < budget:
                source_util = node_util(source_node)
                dest_util = node_util(dest_node)

                if source_util > dest_util + 0.08 and not source_pod.stateful and not source_pod.has_pdb:
                    source_target_util = projected_util(dest_node, source_pod)
                    source_not_moved = not has_pod(moved_pods, source_pod.id)
                    source_ok = (not dest_node.suspended) and source_target_util < 0.68 and source_not_moved
                    if source_ok:
                        out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, dest_pod.current_node))
                        moved_pods.append(source_pod.id)
                        moved = moved + 1
                elif dest_util > source_util + 0.08 and not dest_pod.stateful and not dest_pod.has_pdb:
                    dest_target_util = projected_util(source_node, dest_pod)
                    dest_not_moved = not has_pod(moved_pods, dest_pod.id)
                    dest_ok = (not source_node.suspended) and dest_target_util < 0.68 and dest_not_moved
                    if dest_ok:
                        out.append(move_pod(dest_pod.id, source_pod.current_node))
                        moved_pods.append(dest_pod.id)
                        moved = moved + 1

    return out

# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"

def resource_score(requested: int, capacity: int) -> int:
    if capacity == 0 or requested > capacity:
        return 0
    return ((capacity - requested) * 100) // capacity

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    cpu = resource_score(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request, node.cpu_capacity)
    mem = resource_score(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request, node.mem_capacity)
    return float((cpu + mem) // 2)

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
